idea-plugin.name: Code Reader
idea-plugin.description:
Explains the code you have open in plain, storybook-like language, for people who do not know the programming language. A side panel shows a summary of the file, a story for every method, and a diagram of where each method is used and why.

Explanations are written by the Claude Code CLI or the Codex CLI in headless mode, so one of them must be installed and signed in.

action.description: 열려 있는 코드를 Code Reader 패널에서 쉬운 말로 설명합니다
